answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 65155 Country: India Title: How to prevent from Jinn Question: My niece is about 15 years old. She is misbehaving from around 2months she talks in men's voice and says we are 111 in number and says that we will take her. She is trying to attempt suicide by pressing neck, by jumping and by cutting by knife. Please give me some amal or dua to get rid of this or I can come to Deoband if you call. Answer ID: 65155 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 783/824/L=08/1437) Recite Manzil and Ayatul Kursi and blow over her body. However it is better if you see any religious Amil . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
